family.sans: -apple-system, "system-ui", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

notes: display: the +8 run from 16 covers 3 of 4 measured display size(s); 21 sits outside it. Display bands are commonly geometric — treat this arithmetic fit as a suggestion, not a description.

leading: falloff and exponent are null because the seeds contract names them without stating the curve they parameterise; the measured leading table is emitted in full so a consumer can fit its own model
leading: peak excludes 1 under-sampled size(s) (12px n=1) — a size carried by a handful of elements is not this reference's leading
tracking: tracking does not vary with size — it is a constant 0em across all 3 measured size(s), so there is no zeroAt to find and neither parameter is guessed
